description: Source code implementing MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) based unary tensor operations for PyTorch, including functions for sign, signbit, log1p, logit, and complex tensor operations, with dispatch registration macros.

classes.name: MPSCumulativeOpType
classes.description: Enumeration for cumulative operation types: CUMSUM and CUMPROD.

methods.name: log1p
methods.description: Computes log(1 + input) using MPS graph.

methods.name: lengthOfComplexAsReal
methods.description: Calculates the length of a complex tensor as a real tensor.

methods.name: signbit_out_mps
methods.description: Computes the signbit of a tensor using MPS.

methods.name: sign_out_mps
methods.description: Computes the sign of a tensor using MPS, with fallback for int64 types.

methods.name: frac_out_mps
methods.description: Computes the fractional part of a floating point tensor.

methods.name: logit_mps
methods.description: Computes the logit function with optional epsilon, using MPS.

methods.name: logit_out_mps
methods.description: Computes the logit function and stores result in provided tensor.

methods.name: logit_backward_out_mps
methods.description: Backward pass for logit function, computing gradient.

methods.name: cumsum_out_mps
methods.description: Performs cumulative sum along a dimension using MPS.

methods.name: cumprod_out_mps
methods.description: Performs cumulative product along a dimension using MPS.

methods.name: sgn_out_mps
methods.description: Computes the sign of a tensor, supporting complex tensors.

methods.name: conj_physical_out_mps
methods.description: Computes the conjugate of a complex tensor, excluding double precision.
